name: bd-shop — Crash Rate per Foreground Session

issue_match.program:
# Numerator flow: crashes that occurred while the app was foregrounded, same
# condition as bd-shop-06-crash-foreground.json. Denominator (all-foregrounds,
# in the flow above) is the AppStart count from bd-shop-13 -- the Capture
# SDK's own automatic foreground/background lifecycle log, not app code.
# Background crashes are deliberately excluded from the numerator: they
# cannot be attributed to any specific foreground episode, since no AppStart
# preceded them.
state = string(.app_metrics.running_state) ?? ""
is_foreground = state == "foreground"

if !is_foreground {
  abort
}
